note: What happens when a trainer opens a Kettle Creek building door. home and clinic open the Care panel. The others show their line until their shop exists.
home: Home sweet home. Here is how your Checkling is doing.
clinic: The clinic nurse looks your Checkling over. Medicine is in the Care panel. Untreated sickness gets worse every school day.
store: The General Store is still stocking its shelves. Meals, treats and catching charms are free for now.
apothecary: The apothecary's cauldron is cold for now. Potions are coming.
daycare: Day Care looks after Checklings during long absences. Your teacher can send your party here.
